Thanks for the demo earlier. To get Catalyst set up in our vendor master and enable POs, I need the legal profile and routing info below so AP and Procurement can complete the record. Please either reply with the documents attached or upload to the secure portal link at: https://vendorportal.redwood-inference.com/portal/upload (token included below).

What we need (minimal):
- Legal name as registered with IRS (for master record)
- Legal entity type and jurisdiction (LLC, state/country)
- EIN/tax id and a completed W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent tax form
- Remittance address and preferred invoice email
- PO contact (name + email) and account payable contact
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, routing, account last 4) and either a voided check or bank verification PDF
- Beneficial owners information (if applicable) and UBO declaration

I've attached our blank vendor profile form for completion. If you prefer, you can upload files directly using this one-time tokened link: https://vendorportal.redwood-inference.com/portal/verify?token=8f3b2a
